result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: a loading spinner stuck on top of an already-visible restaurant image, truncated text on a restaurant card, and a partially clipped filter chip at the screen edge. Found 4 issues total (2 major, 2 minor).

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed on top of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' hero image even though the image appears fully loaded, making the card look stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator is removed once the image finishes loading, or hide the underlying image until loading completes so the states don't overlap.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is cut off ('Trattoria Piccol...') with no ellipsis, and its card is clipped at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis for long names, and verify the horizontal carousel shows a clear visual affordance (peek) rather than awkwardly clipping the title text.

issues.description: The last category filter chip on the right (after 'Healthy') is clipped at the screen edge, showing only a small sliver with no readable label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/padding so partially visible chips show enough of their label to indicate scrollability, or add a fade/gradient hint at the edge.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card image uses a plain light gray background, inconsistent with the darker, richer photographic styling of the neighboring restaurant cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image treatment (background, framing) across all restaurant thumbnails, or provide a proper photo/placeholder for that restaurant.
